**ASSESSMENT**

- **Clinical impression (left shoulder):** AC joint sprain / separation (clinician confidence moderate).
- **Evidence-supported differential:** AC joint sprain / separation (strong support).
- **Not yet ruled out:** Brachial plexus neurapraxia (stinger / burner); Clavicle or proximal humerus fracture; Full-thickness rotator cuff tear.
- **Cervical radiculopathy cluster (Wainner 2003):** Negative ULTT A (sensitivity about 97%) makes cervical radiculopathy unlikely.
- **AC joint combination (Chronopoulos 2004):** All three positive: specificity about 97% for AC joint pathology.
- **ROM deficits:** Flexion, Extension, Abduction, External rotation (90° abd), Internal rotation (90° abd) (see ROM table).
- **Strength deficits:** Flexion, Abduction, Scaption (empty can), External rotation, Internal rotation, Extension (see MMT table).
- **Further testing indicated:** External rotation lag sign; Resisted ER weakness; Full can; Pain at end-range elevation, roughly 170–180°.

**PLAN**

- **Activity status:** Out pending physician evaluation.
- **Treatment provided:** cryotherapy.
- **Referral:** Directing physician, within 24–72 hours.
- **Follow-up:** 11/12/2026.
